content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DHSGSU Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 16-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for DHSGSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for the current recruitment drive by Dr. Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya is Junior Research Fellow (JRF). This is a project-based research position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for JRF posts?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at Dr. Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya, Sagar, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DHSGSU JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is 16 September 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach by this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for these JRF posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) positions via Email. The detailed instructions for email application are provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc./M.Tech degree in relevant fields with at least 55% marks and have qualified CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or an equivalent examination.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow post is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories and female candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age relaxation provided for JRF posts?
faq.answer: Yes, a relaxation of 5 years in the upper age limit is provided for SC/ST/OBC/PH and female candidates as per government norms for the JRF position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post?
faq.answer: The salary for JRF is Rs. 37,000/- p.m. + 10% HRA for the first two years, and Rs. 42,000/- p.m. + 10% HRA for the third year.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for DHSGSU JRF Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview, which may be conducted online or offline.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job location for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The job location for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position will be Sagar, Madhya Pradesh, at Dr. Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya (DHSGSU).
